_comment: Parity case PARITY-QD-001: Quick Deploy — legacy /quickdeploy vs v2 /api/v2/sfdc/release-jobs (WO-153)

fieldMapping.NOTE_customerId: NO LEGACY EQUIVALENT — must be supplied externally (intentional v2 boundary identity requirement)
fieldMapping.NOTE_sfdcToolId: NO LEGACY EQUIVALENT — must be supplied externally (intentional v2 boundary identity requirement)
fieldMapping.NOTE_operationType: INFERRED from route (/quickdeploy → QUICK_DEPLOY) in legacy; EXPLICIT in v2

intentionalDifferences.reason: V2 returns HTTP 202 Accepted for asynchronous commands (improved contract)

intentionalDifferences.v2Expected: AcceptedAcknowledgement JSON with jobId, statusUrl, correlationId, operationType, state, acceptedAt
intentionalDifferences.reason: V2 provides typed acknowledgement with job tracking identifier (improved contract)
